- [LLEX.6.4] **Inconsistent indentation** — a leading-space count that
  isn't a multiple of 4 from the enclosing block's indent —
  is a lexer error (`"inconsistent indentation: expected
  multiple of 4 from column M"`). This constraint is
  **suspended inside unbalanced bracket groups** (see
  LLEX.7.5.5); any leading-space count is legal on
  continuation lines inside `( )`, `[ ]`, or `{ }`.
